newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals recover to two-week highs.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals recover to two-week highs.

text.p: New York precious metals futures recovered further Thursday, reaching two-week highs as chart resistance levels were breached, trade demand improved, and investors taking profits in equities and bond markets were tempted back into commodities, analysts said.

"COMEX warehouse stocks of gold and silver have been falling, suggesting demand is up, while U.S. equity and bond markets have come off their highs in the past week, leading investors back into precious metals and prompting more fund shortcovering," FIMAT USA floor trader John Tyree said.
